title: Встроить durable consume в supported path и закрыть replay gate
summary: Подключить P3.2 codec и P3.3 store к supported ConfirmationService/protocol path и выпустить проверяемый receipt, что replay больше не живёт в instance memory.
why: Codec and store do not close F02 while `ConfirmationProtocol` still writes `$spentTokens` / `_spentTokens` and P2.3 still labels consume baseline-partial. `RAG:—`.

include: Constructor wiring of key provider, clock, iss/aud and store; removal of production process-local sets; presentation-consume before current authorization; structured P3 codes on the supported path; restart/multi-worker gate; PHP/Dart parity receipt; residual notes for P6/P7/P8.
exclude: P2 authorization/policy redesign; event append; new spec revision; final barrel/PSR-4 removals; public docs/release; claiming exactly-once tool side effects.

rules: Supported constructors require `TokenKeyProvider` and `ConfirmationTokenStore`; omitting them is a construction error, not a silent local set. Spend/consume remains after binding checks and before current authorization. Authorization denial refines outcome and still returns spent on retry. Legacy `TokenSigner` adapters may wrap a one-key provider for focused tests only. Reference tenant signer migrates to the key provider. Receipt derives case/result/code sets from real test output and names P5/P6/P7/P8 residual owners. No safe result claims exactly-once external effect.
guidance: Delete production `$spentTokens`/`_spentTokens`. Keep P2 redaction rules. Do not log raw tokens. Layer tests must fail if a new in-class spent set reappears. PostgreSQL restart test is mandatory for close; in-memory restart is not a substitute.
